relationships.subject: hAMSC-VEGF189-GFP
relationships.evidence_quote: Strikingly, in the hAMSC-VEGF189-GFP transplant group, enhanced expression of TRPV1 in Vc was slightly reduced when compared with the hAMSC-Vector-GFP injected group (Fig. 4A, B).

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of locally applied hAMSC-VEGF189-GFP to Vc attenuated mechanical allodynia, which was partially blocked by coadministration of capsaicin (Fig. 4E).

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Our study also reports TRPV1 suppression by VEGF expression in Vc.

key_findings: VEGF189-expressing human adipose MSCs relieved mechanical allodynia in 6-OHDA Parkinson mice and reduced TRPV1 in trigeminal subnucleus caudalis, with no tumor formation over 6 weeks.
Capsaicin partially blocked the analgesic effect, implicating TRPV1 downregulation.
